root_cause.text: nft_tunnel_obj_destroy() directly freed the metadata_dst via metadata_dst_free() without respecting the dst_entry reference count, allowing use-after-free when packets still holding references via dst_hold() were later processed.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "nft_tunnel_obj_destroy() calls metadata_dst_free() which directly kfree()s the metadata_dst, ignoring the dst_entry refcount. Packets that took a reference via dst_hold() in nft_tunnel_obj_eval() and are still queued (e.g. in a netem qdisc) are left with a dangling pointer." The patch replaces metadata_dst_free() with dst_release() to properly decrement the refcount.
